stanza: These buildings could drift out to sea
Still, there's no place I'd rather be
See, nothing even matters to me

q.line: And it's a disaster, such a catastrophe
q.linePrev: In the fact that I got everyone kissin' my ass
q.lineNext: For you to see so damn much of my ass, you asked for me?

q.line: Full of people all absorbed in their own personal catastrophes
stanza: I remember looking around a hospital waiting room
Full of people all absorbed in their own personal catastrophes
All reading books like Being Mortal, all with a look in their eyes
And I remember still feeling like, "No, no one can understand"
